noun_definition: Manual request refers to the process of requesting money in the application by manually entering an amount before proceeding to the confirmation page.
Amount refers to the numerical value entered by the user to request money, which is expected to be displayed on the confirmation page after adding a receipt.
Confirmation page refers to the interface displayed after entering an amount for a manual money request, where the user expects to see the entered amount along with the option to add a receipt.
Receipt refers to a document or proof of a transaction that is added during the manual request process to support the entered amount on the confirmation page.
